title: "Compacting the Uncompactable" by Bobby Powers
summary: Bobby Powers presents Mesh, a drop-in malloc replacement that eliminates memory fragmentation in unmodified C/C++ programs by compacting memory. The talk covers how it works despite C's fixed object addresses, and its benefits for programs like Redis.
why: Recommended as a great talk on solving fragmentation for C/C++ and runtimes like Ruby and Python without code changes.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: There was a great talk at Strange Loop about a drop-in malloc replacement which compacts.
